subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should QQBot adopt the established fixed 30-second fail-closed WebSocket opening-handshake budget, coordinated with the maxPayload change in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99075?
rationale: The code and ws contract establish that the fix works, but selecting a permanent connection budget intentionally changes behavior for unusually slow gateways or proxies and therefore needs QQBot owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve 30 seconds and rebase
options.body: Accept the sibling-channel timeout policy and refresh the branch so both QQBot WebSocket option changes receive one coherent final review.

options.title: Select another fixed budget
options.body: Choose a different owner-approved constant and update the constructor assertions and real loopback proof to match.

options.title: Pause the timeout change
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until production QQBot or proxy evidence establishes an acceptable fail-closed budget.

recommendation.title: Approve 30 seconds and rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the sibling-channel timeout policy and refresh the branch so both QQBot WebSocket option changes receive one coherent final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged architecture work owns the current QQBot gateway connection lifecycle affected by this timeout.
